newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl says no cabinet reshuffle before 1998 poll.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says no cabinet reshuffle before 1998 poll.

text.p: Germany's Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Wednesday he had no intention of reshuffling his cabinet before the next general election in 1998.
Kohl's remarks in an interview with the Cologne Stadt Anzeiger daily newspaper were released ahead of publication on Thursday.

When asked if he foresaw cabinet changes before the poll, he told the newspaper: "I see no reason to do this. Why should I change anything? We work together well in the coalition and we will share our success".

Last month Kohl dismissed cabinet reshuffle speculation in response to rumours Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt was under pressure to resign from within his party -- Kohl's junior coalition partner the Free Democrats.
